verdict.rationale: Mixpanel offers a Feature Flags API for assigning users to variants for experiments, rollouts, and releases, and separately supports cohort creation via user properties, but the evidence doesn't confirm that flag targeting rules can combine user properties, cohorts, and percentage rollouts within the same flag configuration. missing for 10: documentation showing flag targeting rules that combine user-property conditions, cohort membership, and percentage-based rollout in one flag; UI/API details on how targeting criteria are configured; independent/hands-on confirmation of this workflow.
